identities: data/development.jsonl; all six preselected upstream groups, no replacement after failures
hypothesis: Original upstream JOIN SQL can be replayed by an independent relational engine even when the old complete contract rejects it; this does not establish scientific benefit.
controls: Old unchanged v5 complete contract prepare (no solver)
Original unchanged SQL on SQLite, same full schema and separately checked complete source constraints for each fixed no-NULL fixture
fixtures: tiny_synthetic (explicitly artificial rows, original queries unmodified)
primary_observation: Count returned/error/contract rejected; outputs retained without semantic gold inference
failure_policy: Retain all failures. No parser repair, no source SQL rewriting, no dropping columns/constraints, no reselecting easier examples.
dialect_cautions: SQLite integer division differs from MySQL decimal division
Non-grouped selected columns may be nondeterministic or invalid under other modes
SQLite return/difference never supplies upstream natural-defect label
stop: Any source hash mismatch before starting; resource stop means all unreturned slots NOT_RUN; no retry or escalation to large run
confirmation: NOT_RUN; reserve contains previously screened material and is not pristine final test
